agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance, evidence calibration, and separation from local adoption

analytical_question: What broad significance is supported, and how much should it influence this application decision?
general_et_finding: Broad classification: Potentially Promethean as a conditional synthetic candidate, not confirmed or inevitable [E1]. G2 scope is a general-purpose platform; stipulated cross-domain discontinuous demonstrations and a foundational production/coordination mechanism support higher potential. Counterevidence: durability, access, generalization and infrastructure/complements remain unestablished. Breakthrough with limited reach is a plausible competing interpretation. Actual-world classification is Undetermined because G2 and its evidence are fictional.
application_finding: Application significance: proposed internal campaign planning; broad G2 potential does not establish local value, implementation success or strategic necessity. Compare planning quality, effort, risk and full cost with the incumbent workflow; no measured improvement [E2].
organization_specific_finding: Organization-specific implication: missing data/integration and evaluation expertise make present fit unestablished. Broad significance does not justify bypassing prerequisites; prioritize feasibility and evidence collection before any live use [E2].

evidence.claim: [E1] Technology scope, capability/baseline, and for/against higher significance.
evidence.date_or_recency: Undated synthetic assumptions; not current external evidence
evidence.notes: No actual technology or historical claim independently verified. Supports conditional reasoning only.

evidence.claim: [E2] Proposed task, organizational constraints/posture and lack of local validation.
evidence.source_or_reference: cases/broad_potential.json: intended_application, organization, capabilities_constraints and adoption_posture
evidence.notes: No measured benefit or readiness finding; posture cannot change E1.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Strongest contrary interpretation: G2 is a multi-domain breakthrough with limited eventual structural reach; complements, generalization, access and durable institutional effects may not materialize.
Even stipulated cross-domain demonstrations do not establish civilization-scale realization or suitability for the small agency.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in scenario-internal reasoning; low or undetermined confidence for actual-world significance and local outcomes. Societal duration, probability and timing are unquantified. Codex example evaluation, not an independent ChatGPT session or empirical experiment.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential value: better screening/planning or reduced effort, conditional on controlled local outcomes and full costs. No measured ROI, savings or long-run structural benefit is asserted.
risk_governance_implication: Potential harms include spend errors, unsuitable recommendations, data-rights issues, review/integration costs and hype-driven overinvestment. Broad transformation may also bring distributional and governance effects, but no net societal benefit is established.
recommendation_management_implication: Treat broad significance as a reason to investigate and monitor, not to approve adoption. Define outcome, safety, cost, learning and time gates before testing. Stop/redesign local work if those agreed gates fail; continue proportionate technology monitoring rather than escalating merely because of long-range potential. Actual investment/adoption approval belongs to adoption and readiness specialists.
change_monitoring_triggers: Independent comparable capability results and scoped replication.
Verified cross-domain use and durable structural outcomes rather than publicity alone.
Evidence that infrastructure, skills, governance and access conditions exist.
Controlled local advertiser outcomes, full costs and safety/rights results against pre-agreed gates.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Obtain original dated evidence before any real-world label or historical claim.
Adoption: actual adopt/wait/reject or investment approval.
Organizational-readiness: data quality/rights, skills, integration and controls.
Diffusion: actual uptake and spread; landscape: actual vendors/competitors and infrastructure.
Innovation/disruption: customer substitution, value capture and business-model exposure.
